milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the purple terracotta pillar (centered at spawn-relative [8, 1, 10]) and face it, modeling that the player has located the landmark. The pillar is ~12 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=16 allows detection from nearby. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is actually looking at the terracotta rather than facing away.

Uses inventory_has because mining light_gray_concrete_powder drops the block item into the player's inventory (concrete powder drops itself when mined without water contact, and there is no water in this scene). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a furnace places it in the player's inventory. The player must mine 8 cobblestone blocks (exposed behind the concrete powder wall) and use the crafting table at spawn-relative [6, 0, 8] to craft a furnace (8 cobblestone in a ring pattern). This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory.
